newsitem.title: USA: Primergy partners file settlement offer with FERC.
newsitem.headline: Primergy partners file settlement offer with FERC.

text.p: Wisconsin Energy Corp and Northern States Power Co said Thursday they jointly filed a unilateral settlement offer with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC).
The companies filed an application on July 10, 1995 seeking FERC's approval of their proposed merger. The combined company would be called Primergy.

An administrative law judge appointed by FERC conditionally approved the merger on August 29. The offer of settlement addresses points made in that approval while fleshing out specific details of the proposed independent system operator for Primergy.

According to the proposal, the independent system operator (ISO) has control over scheduling of use of the transmission facilities and scheduling of maintenance, reviews and approves all existing operating guides and will receive in advance for its approval a daily generation unit commitment schedule from the Primergy utilities.
"We believe the ISO detailed in this offer of settlement resolves all transmission-related market power issues FERC has regarding our merger application," Wisconsin Energy said.
